definitions.gloss: to donate; to contribute; to give (money, goods) to a cause or organization
definitions.explanation: To voluntarily give money or goods to a charity, religious institution, or public cause without expecting anything in return.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寄付|きふ}した。
examples.english: I donated to the disaster area.

examples.japanese: NPO⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{千円|せんえん}→千円：08980_senen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寄付|きふ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I donate a thousand yen every month to an NPO.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかけ→呼びかけ：11855_yobikake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じた→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧。
examples.english: Many citizens responded to the call for donations toward the construction of the library.

notes:
The standard word for making charitable donations. Can be used as both a noun (⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧) and a verb ({寄付|きふ}する). In Japan, donation culture has grown significantly, especially after major natural disasters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧: to solicit donations
- ⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧{金|きん}: donation money
- ⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}ける→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧: to accept donations
- ⟦{匿名|とくめい}→匿名：11797_tokumei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寄付|きふ}する: to donate anonymously
- ⟦ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}→ふるさと納税：17628_furusatonouzei⟧: hometown tax donation (a popular tax-deductible donation system)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寄贈|きぞう}→寄贈：12345_kizou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to donate (goods, especially books or artworks) — focuses on physical items given to institutions
- ⟦{献金|けんきん}→献金：13497_kenkin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a monetary contribution — often political or religious
- ⟦{募金|ぼきん}→募金：11830_bokin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to collect donations — refers to the act of fundraising, not giving
